patterns.explain_zh: by 后面接变化了多少，to 后面接最后停在哪个数。

correct.en: Revenue rose by 18%.
correct.zh: 收入上升了 18%。

correct.en: Revenue rose to RMB 92 million.
correct.zh: 收入上升到 9,200 万元。

wrong.why_zh: 变化量用 by，不用 of。
如果 92 是终点，要用 to；by 会变成增加了 9,200 万。

patterns.explain_zh: 同时给出起点和终点时，用 from A to B；如果只给一个范围，用 between A and B。

correct.en: Orders rose from 1,200 to 2,100.
Orders fluctuated between 8,000 and 12,000.
correct.zh: 订单在 8,000 到 12,000 之间波动。

patterns.explain_zh: 份额从 46% 到 52% 是 6 个百分点；说 6% 会被理解成相对增长了 6%。

correct.en: Its share rose 6 percentage points, from 46% to 52%.
correct.zh: 它的份额上升 6 个百分点，从 46% 到 52%。

wrong.why_zh: 两个百分数相减，结果要用 percentage points。

patterns.explain_zh: 倍数用 as … as，不用 higher than。

correct.en: East China's revenue was twice as high as Northeast's.
correct.zh: 华东收入是东北的两倍。

correct.en: Revenue was three times the figure for the northeast.
correct.zh: 收入是东北的三倍。

wrong.en: Revenue was twice higher than the northeast.
wrong.why_zh: 英语里没有 twice higher than 这种说法。

patterns.explain_zh: double 作动词表示变成两倍；twice 是副词，常和 as … as 连用。

correct.en: Revenue doubled between 2025 and 2026.
correct.zh: 收入在 2025 到 2026 年间翻了一倍。

correct.en: Revenue was twice as high as in 2025.
correct.zh: 收入是 2025 年的两倍。

wrong.why_zh: double 不能这样当名词用；说 doubled 或 increased twofold。

patterns.explain_zh: 表示占多少比例，用 account for、make up 或 represent，不用 occupy。

correct.en: Mobile accounts for 52% of revenue.
correct.zh: 手机应用占收入的 52%。

correct.en: Private-label goods make up 18% of sales.
correct.zh: 自有品牌商品占销售额的 18%。

wrong.why_zh: occupy 指占据空间，不用于份额。

patterns.explain_zh: 最高级前面通常加 the；不要叠加 most 和 -est。

correct.en: East China had the highest revenue.
correct.zh: 华东收入最高。

correct.en: This was the most expensive quarter.
correct.zh: 这是成本最高的一个季度。

wrong.en: East China had the most highest revenue.
wrong.why_zh: highest 已经是最高级，不能再加 most。

patterns.explain_zh: 比较两个数字时用 compared with；句子要有明确主语。

correct.en: Revenue fell to 38%, compared with 44% a year earlier.
correct.zh: 收入降到 38%，而一年前是 44%。

wrong.en: Compared with last year, sales increased this year.
wrong.why_zh: 主语和比较对象不清楚；改成 Sales increased this year, compared with last year.

patterns.explain_zh: respectively 放在句末，前面的数值顺序要和对象顺序一致。

correct.en: East and South China recorded RMB 520,000 and RMB 430,000 respectively.
correct.zh: 华东和华南分别录得 52 万元和 43 万元。

wrong.en: East and South China recorded RMB 430,000 and RMB 520,000 respectively.
wrong.why_zh: 数值顺序反了，respectively 就对应错了。

patterns.explain_zh: 近似词后面直接接数字；nearly 和 near 不要混用。

correct.en: Nearly 40% of revenue came from the east.
correct.zh: 接近 40% 的收入来自华东。

correct.en: Just over 30% of users opened the app daily.
correct.zh: 略高于 30% 的用户每天打开应用。

wrong.en: Near 40% of revenue came from the east.
wrong.why_zh: 表示近似数量用 nearly，不用 near。

patterns.title_en: peak at / reach a peak of
patterns.explain_zh: peak at 后面直接接数值；reach a peak of 更完整。

correct.en: Orders peaked at 15,000 in December.
correct.zh: 订单在十二月达到 15,000 的峰值。

correct.en: Revenue reached a peak of RMB 92 million.
correct.zh: 收入达到 9,200 万元的峰值。

wrong.en: Orders reached the peak at 15,000 in December.
wrong.why_zh: 更自然的说法是 peaked at 或 reached a peak of。

patterns.explain_zh: while 和 whereas 后面都要接完整从句，不能直接接名词短语。

correct.en: Revenue grew in the east, whereas it stagnated in the northeast.
correct.zh: 华东收入增长，而东北停滞。

wrong.en: Revenue grew in the east, whereas a fall in the northeast.
wrong.why_zh: whereas 后面缺主语和谓语。

patterns.explain_zh: 可数名词用 fewer，不可数名词用 less；人数、订单数用 number，不用 amount。

correct.en: Fewer customers canceled their orders this month.
correct.zh: 这个月取消订单的客户更少。

correct.en: There was less demand for delivery on Sunday.
correct.zh: 周日的配送需求更少。

patterns.explain_zh: in 接某个时间点或时间段；by 表示到某个时间为止完成。

correct.en: Revenue reached RMB 92 million in 2026.
correct.zh: 收入在 2026 年达到 9,200 万元。

correct.en: The company aims to reach RMB 150 million by 2028.
correct.zh: 公司目标是在 2028 年前达到 1.5 亿元。

wrong.en: The company aims to reach RMB 150 million in 2028.
wrong.why_zh: 如果意思是“到 2028 年为止”，要用 by。
